blocks.html:
USI unfortunately does not have on-campus housing to accommodate all students, who should therefore seek accommodation on their own.

Further information on housing is available on the InfoDesk, the portal with all practicalities for the USI community:

  • Housing in Lugano / Mendrisio
  • USI Home (Lugano campus, official USI residence)
  • Casa dell'Accademia (Mendrisio campus, official USI residence)
  • Rental listings database
  • Student accommodations (third party housing solutions, not managed by USI)
  • Useful information on Swiss regulations
  • Advisory services for tenants
  • FAQ

Facebook pages

The Housing service manages two Facebook pages to encourage direct contact among students, co-tenancy and sub-letting arrangements and, more generally, the circulation of information regarding available accommodations:

  • Lugano housing Facebook page
  • Mendrisio housing Facebook page

Want to let?

USI organises and regularly updates an online database with all sorts of property letting adverts.

Letting agents and private property owners can take advantage of our database by directly posting their adverts by accessing it through the website https://alloggi.usi.ch/annunci/.

The Housing Service reserves the right to turn down any adverts, which for whatever reason, at its discretion, it considers to be unsuitable.
